scope: Exact row fingerprint and authenticated-source provenance digest representation; no authentication, runtime grant, original-source acceptance, DDL promotion or write execution
algorithm: lowercase SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 JCS with closed ASCII property names; no Unicode/case/whitespace normalization

row.facts_source: Every row fact must be scanned independently from the exact locked SQL row in the maintenance transaction. Do not reconstruct materialized values from the supplied original file and call them observed SQL facts.
row.row_id: Canonical positive unsigned-64 decimal STRING, no leading zero/sign; permits the entire BIGINT UNSIGNED range without JSON number precision loss
row.row_version: exactly 1 as required by pinned formal 066 immutable config schema
row.copied_from_version: explicit JSON null or safe integer 1 <= value < version; no omission/null-to-zero conversion
row.created_by: Exact valid UTF-8 text, 1..128 BYTES as required by chk_sb_config_created_by OCTET_LENGTH; do not count Unicode characters or truncate.
row.change_reason: Explicit JSON null or exact valid UTF-8 text, 1..512 BYTES as required by chk_sb_config_reason OCTET_LENGTH. Empty nonnull string rejects.
row.created_at: original MySQL DATETIME(6) UTC value, year 1000..9999, exact microsecond precision, formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.ffffffZ; reject offsets and submicrosecond rounding
row.materialized: Closed object containing EVERY effective config SQL column in pinned 066, including enabled/profile/minimum, all durations/capacity/concurrency/preflight columns, all registry version/hash pairs and all typed reference identity/version pairs. Values are exact SQL scalar TEXT: booleans 0/1, integers canonical decimal, source_size_safety_factor exactly two decimal places. Lossless driver decoding only; no float64 or trimming.
row.original_check: Require exact UTF-8 JCS ConfigValues source, 2..262144 bytes, identical stored SHA-256/size and EVERY independently supplied materialized column. Extra/missing/mismatched columns reject without a digest.
row.canonical_column: canonical_config_json deliberately excluded from immutable row fingerprint because NULL -> exact original bytes is the one permitted change. Separately inspect NULL/same/different under the same lock before and after writing; exclusion never authorizes arbitrary changes.
row.disclosure: Canonical row-identity JSON is internal comparison material and may contain original legacy metadata. Persist/audit only its digest and separately approved redacted details; do not expose this JSON as an Admin response or log raw source/legacy reason.
row.evolution: Any new immutable config column or row schema change requires explicit fingerprint/profile and schema/catalog review; never silently omit unknown columns

provenance.source_issuer: independently authenticated stable logical archive authority identity, 1..2048 UTF-8 bytes, non-whitespace; not a caller claim or rotating key thumbprint
provenance.source_id: exact immutable original archive record locator, 1..2048 UTF-8 bytes, non-whitespace; not a mutable current filesystem pathname or a newly reconstructed configuration
provenance.attestation_sha256: 64 lowercase hex SHA-256 of exact independently authenticated archive manifest bytes binding the original record ID/version, complete target/config tuple and original raw canonical bytes
provenance.authentication_required: Authenticate the original archive record and its target binding using an independently reviewed source authority/manifest wire profile. This digest and its accepted input shape do not establish provenance or approve any issuer/key/signature profile.
provenance.final_guard: Recheck the same immutable source/attestation identity, raw source digest/size and target before caller-owned commit; freeze original bytes before callbacks. A newly signed statement over a reconstruction is not historical original provenance.

integration.expected_row_sha256: SHA-256 of row profile above, independently compared with the purpose-specific grant and original request
integration.source_provenance_sha256: SHA-256 of provenance profile above, independently compared with the purpose-specific grant and original request
integration.receipt_schema: D maintenance receipt v1 must explicitly select both v1 identity profiles; preserve original request facts on replay/unknown-commit observation
integration.authorization: Verify current independent write/observation authority, revocation, DB clock, exact target/version/key and schema/catalog/migration pins. Read receipts or identity digests never grant writes.
integration.transaction: Full locked row and source checks, NULL-to-original or exact no-change, actual intent/result audit IDs and maintenance receipt must be atomic. Audit/capacity/receipt/final-guard failure rolls back. Never use config_update for backfill.

vector_scope: Seven independent synthetic Node/Go vectors, including exact SQL DECIMAL 1.00/1.50/2.00; no original historical files or runtime authorization
correction: Formal 066 CHECK constraints, not VARCHAR character capacities, govern metadata admission. Old claims of 128/512 Unicode characters and empty nonnull reason were wrong. Tighten validation only; canonical bytes for every valid formal SQL row remain unchanged. Also normalize the expected DECIMAL(4,2) text from validated scaled integers; shortest JCS numeric text is not the actual fixed SQL scale. Do not normalize independently scanned SQL facts.
